workflow: AutoCAD 24.3 desktop COM creates twelve native standard entity families in an isolated scratch document, drives ROTATE from base 100,200 through a two-point 45-degree Reference to absolute 135 degrees, performs one U, then exercises numeric, point, negative and numeric-Reference/point-target inputs plus a mixed editable/locked pickset
